profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Inductive Automation

positions.title: Webmaster and Music Producer
positions.description:
Webmaster:
- Designed and developed website for a company selling educational products.
- Created site graphics
- Maintain SEO and metadata for social media
- Manage email accounts
- Maintain client mailing list

Music Producer:
- Arrange, program, record, mix, and master original recordings of children's music
- Instrumental music produced through synthesis, sampling, and live recording
- Produce sheet music for song books

positions.title: Audio/Video Technician
positions.description:
• Responsible for filming, live editing, and broadcasting city meetings.
• Live video editing and audio mixing, record keeping, and timely troubleshooting. 
• Ensure smooth operation of audio and video technology during meetings.

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
• Ran front desk and cash register at 16-lane bowling alley and arcade.
• Ensured customer satisfaction through above-and-beyond service.
• As a trainer of new staff, I imparted a culture of respect, cleanliness, and professionalism to a new
generation of employees.

positions.title: Server Assistant
positions.description:
• Assisted servers of an upscale restaurant and wine bar at Lake Tahoe.
• Greeted customers, bussed tables, prepared and served warm bread and cold water, cleaned and stocked restaurant.
• Experience hosting and taking orders from customers.

positions.title: Station Operator
positions.description:
• Produced live television programs for the UCD Student Housing Channel with a team of peers.
• Received training in studio filming, audio, studio upkeep, troubleshooting, directing, technical
directing, and floor management.

projects.title: Autism Sing-Along! Social Songs
projects.description: A new album of children's music designed to engage students.
